projectDescription: A community-curated directory of /uses pages where developers share their hardware, software, tools, and configurations.
keyFeatures: Community-curated directory of /uses pages from thousands of developers
Filter by technology tags (JavaScript, React, Python, etc.)
Filter by country using flag emoji
Filter by device (Apple, Windows, Linux, BSD, iPhone, Android)
Automated PR validation via GitHub Actions
Remix-powered full-stack web app deployed on Netlify
publicApiSurface: Person data schema (name, description, url, country, twitter, mastodon, bluesky, emoji, computer, phone, tags)
getPeople(tag?) — returns filtered and shuffled list of contributors
tags() — returns all technology tags with usage counts
countries() — returns all countries with contributor counts
devices() — returns device types with usage counts
normalizeTag(tag) — normalizes tag strings for consistent matching
